description: P09-w1-fixture-capability-evidence: evidence job for the debugger coverage fixture; never delivered. ODC negative: Client Variables typed Binary Data, entity Record, structure Record, Text List and structure List; Verify reports UnallowedTypeForClientVariable for each (expectValid false). It has no expectError because the refusal is a Verify error, not a thrown op: OdcJobTests.JobAppliesAndVerifies (tests/jobs-odc) executes this shape, NegativeJobs only takes expectError jobs.
